name: Collections Analyst
description: Performs premium payment processing and grace-period lapse billing administration across the Business Operations value stream. Captures inbound premiums, executes scheduled EFT draft runs, manages premium suspense, and resolves declined-payment exceptions. Executes lapses and reinstatements for unpaid policies and processes premium refunds through the policy administration and billing platforms.

name: Commercial Lines Underwriter
description: Owns commercial risk selection and policy binding within the Underwriting value stream, negotiating quote terms and issuing revised quotes to brokers. Administers the reinsurance program, screening treaty retention and submitting quarterly bordereaux, and processes mid-term endorsements. Monitors portfolio concentration and appetite exceptions, reporting status to committee and maintaining underwriting quality assurance.

name: Commission Analyst
description: Supports distribution operations across the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, maintaining producer pipeline data and logging bound submissions in the CRM. Coordinates agency and broker relationship governance and delegated authority oversight, tracking corrective actions and escalating overdue items. Produces customer insights and retention cross-sell analytics while securing compliance sign-off on partner materials.

name: Communications Specialist
description: Coordinates stakeholder engagement and communications planning for change initiatives within the Program Management Office value stream. Conducts change impact assessments and readiness baselines, mapping affected stakeholders and identifying high-risk impacts. Supports training delivery and resistance management, measures adoption, and produces adoption completion reports that feed benefits tracking.

name: Compensation & Benefits Manager
description: Oversees benefits strategy and administration across the Human Resources & Talent value stream, leading open enrollment from window close through carrier file submission and discrepancy resolution. Administers leave management, workplace accommodations, and retirement programs, including distribution processing. Manages carrier relationships and voluntary benefits while running financial wellness programs through the HRIS.

name: Compensation Analyst
description: Administers producer and incentive compensation across the Sales, Distribution & Marketing and Human Resources & Talent value streams. Loads commission rates, safeguards commission system data integrity, calculates performance-share payouts, and adjudicates commission disputes. Supports annual compensation planning by updating salary bands, validating manager recommendations, and running regression analyses with controls to prevent pay-gap recurrence.

name: Competitive Intelligence Analyst
description: Performs cross-functional analysis spanning Risk, Compliance & Audit, Human Resources & Talent, and Data & AI value streams from the PMO's Analysis & Quality department. Supports market conduct examinations by drafting and validating examiner responses and tracking corrective-action remediation. Contributes to control framework design, pay equity analysis, and executive portfolio governance reviews using GRC and data warehouse platforms.

name: Complaints Manager
description: Leads complaint resolution and producer complaint handling within the Call Center value stream, finalizing resolution determinations and confirming corrective actions. Oversees complaint regulatory reporting, applying response standards, drafting response letters, and filing notifications for terminated-for-cause producers. Runs complaint analytics, benchmarking ratios per 1,000 policies, and flags bad-faith or litigation-risk complaints for escalation.

name: Complaints Specialist
description: Performs formal complaint intake, investigation, and resolution within the Call Center value stream, reviewing documentation, assessing merits, and determining resolution actions within authority. Tracks regulatory acknowledgment deadlines and approves remediation, coordinating process or script changes with operations. Produces quarterly complaint trend reports and root-cause analyses that identify recurring failure patterns.

name: Complex / Large Loss Claims Specialist
description: Owns complex and large-loss files within the Claims value stream, managing liability evaluation, ongoing claim handling, and structured settlement placement. Documents liability decisions, orders IMEs when evidence is insufficient, and logs suit notices against claim files. Administers denial management and release agreements while maintaining claims workflow routing and vendor network directories in the claims platform.

name: Compliance Analyst
description: Performs compliance testing, regulatory change management, and policy governance across the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, with substantial Cybersecurity & IAM coverage. Supports market conduct examinations and compliance issue response, tracking audit-deficiency remediation to closure in the GRC platform. Scopes cyber risk assessments, assigns control ownership, monitors key risk indicators, and maintains security awareness training curricula.

name: Compliance Manager
description: Leads compliance issue response within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, assigning investigation leads, triaging issues, and notifying the CCO of major findings. Manages regulatory change, risk assessments, and the risk appetite framework, proposing limit recalibrations on material change. Oversees third-party and cyber risk monitoring, tracking vendor SLA performance and corrective-action remediation through the GRC platform.

name: Compliance Officer
description: Oversees compliance issue response and regulatory change management across the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, triaging issues and escalating major matters to the CCO. Administers the risk appetite framework and risk assessments, validating KRI data quality and reconciling anomalies with data owners. Directs examination corrective-action plans and third-party cyber risk monitoring, capturing loss events in the GRC platform.
